title: PK
desc: An innocent alien lands on Earth but loses his communication device. However, he meets Jaggu, a heartbroken reporter, and tries to find his device with her help.

title: Maattrraan
desc: A pair of conjoined twins, opposite in personality, strive to overcome challenges and confront a Russian spy who plans to destroy their father's business.

title: Oppam
desc: Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.

title: MLA Mani Patham Classum Gusthiyum
desc: Manikandan is devastated when his sister, Meenakshi, commits suicide after getting raped by Varkey, an evil politician, and sets out to take revenge on him.

title: Hit List
desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure abducts his family. Forced into a dark world of violence, he becomes an unwilling assassin, targeting the kidnapper's enemies.
